gn2_pad.label: GN2 drawing (the Layer X tab's default drawing), on the pad

checks.detail: Estimated, not measured or from a datasheet: TK-LOX 1000 psi, TK-FUEL 1000 psi, COPV-GN2 6750 psi. The MAWP checks and the optimiser's tank-pressure ceiling stand on these.

At 578 psia the LOX tank's pressurant use is set by the cold wall the gas meets (the wall uncovered as LOX drains, and the upper wall chilled during loading), not by condensation on the liquid (grams). With the tank wall unmodelled, LOX-side gas use reads low: estimated +7 % with a warm upper wall to +60 % with one at 120-150 K. A full bottle still holds lockup; do not fill it short until bottle use has been measured on a firing.
The drawing's tank is 15.10 L; the config's is 6.44 L. The burn follows the drawing. A different ullage is a different blowdown.
